concepts.description: Learning the basic rules that govern multiplication, including order, identity, and zero properties.
key_ideas: Order Property: Changing the order of numbers does not change the product (e.g., 4×5 = 5×4)
Multiplicative Identity: Any number multiplied by 1 is the number itself
Zero Property: Any number multiplied by 0 is 0

concepts.description: Applying division concepts to solve real-life scenarios involving grouping and sharing.
